title: From request to production, through a human gate
caption: G0–G5 are the gates of the working contract I use at Eclipse, where the roles are steps one session applies in sequence.

req.label: Ignacio
req.note: Every change starts with a request from me and follows the same path.

chief.label: Direction
chief.note: Owns the plan, the scope and the cost, and hands each task to the right role.

spec.label: Specification
spec.note: Problem, user, flow, requirements, exclusions, acceptance criteria, how to roll back, cost and owner.

agents.label: Role agents
agents.note: Each one starts with its discovery skill and states its assumptions in a fixed block before implementing.

skills.label: Skills
skills.note: Short guides loaded when the action needs them: discovery to start, layer or component ones to build, testing ones to close.

repo.label: Branch + PR
repo.note: One batch, one branch and one PR at a time.

qa.label: QA
qa.note: Type check, lint, tests, build and captures at 360 and 1440 px; then another reviewer tries to refute each finding.

gate.label: Human gate
gate.note: Merging, deploying, spending, changing prices or publishing is my call, with an explicit, separate authorisation.

pub.label: Publish
pub.note: Merge and deploy come after G5, with my authorisation.
